text:
sarah_support: Customer asked for an ISO mapping "evidence pack" tied to a support incident INC-4321 — they want audit log retention policy, a redacted sample of audit log entries for a 502 incident window, KMS/HSM attestation, and the mapping spreadsheet for ISO controls. Deadline requested: EOD next Tue.

devon_eng: Can do sample logs + repro steps. Need org id and exact time window for the 502s.

sarah_support: Org id: org-9b2a. They reported 502 spikes around 2026-02-18 14:20–14:45 UTC. Also asked for a demo of how logs are exported to S3 and proof of retention enforcement.

devon_eng: Repro/collection steps for redacted slice:
```bash
scripts/get_audit_slice.sh --org org-9b2a --start '2026-02-18T14:00:00Z' --end '2026-02-18T15:00:00Z' --redact
```
This outputs a redacted JSON file and a checksums.txt (sha256) for tamper-proofing.

elaine_security: For ISO mapping we normally include: Audit Logging Control Matrix v2.1 (PDF), KMS Key Lifecycle SOP, and a sample log file with hash chain proof. Auditor preference? PDF archive or Confluence links?

sarah_support: Auditor asked for signed artifacts (PDF) + one downloadable sample (presigned S3 URL) — they'll accept the presigned link for the redacted logs.

patrick_compliance: Retention statement to include: "Account-level audit events — 7 years; Authentication/session events — 2 years; Debug/ephemeral events — 1 year." Reference retention policy ID RP-2025-07. Note: for Dedicated/Private customers we state customer-managed retention. Also confirm KMS: hosted uses AWS KMS + YubiHSM for HSM-backed signing; we'll include the key lifecycle excerpt.

elaine_security: We can include an attestation excerpt (vendor-supplied) — summary of HSM properties (FIPS 140-2 compatible) from the 2025-11-03 attestation. Ops will generate the redacted attestation PDF.

nate_sre: Correlation note for the 502s: I checked proxy traces and there was a backend spike at ~14:23 UTC. Pull trace ids with: 
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://console.redwood.ai/api/traces?org=org-9b2a&from=2026-02-18T14:20:00Z&to=2026-02-18T14:45:00Z&status=502'
```
I will attach the matched trace ids and the mapping to audit event IDs.

sarah_support: Two deliverables needed from engineering/compliance/security: (1) redacted sample log + presigned S3 link; (2) compiled PDF evidence pack (mapping spreadsheet, KMS/HSM attestation excerpt, retention policy). ETA?

devon_eng: I can produce the redacted log slice and presigned link by EOD today. I'll drop into bucket: compliance-evidence/org-9b2a/INC-4321/ and share the link.

patrick_compliance: I'll assemble the control mapping spreadsheet and run it by Legal tomorrow morning. Expect the consolidated PDF by 2026-02-23.

elaine_security: :thumbsup: I'll request the HSM attestation from the vendor now — vendor SLA ~48 hours. Will redact serials before inclusion.

ops_bot: Ticket INC-4321 updated: evidence pack in progress — logs by EOD (today), mapping PDF target 2026-02-23, HSM attestation expected ~2026-02-25.

sarah_support: Thanks all — I'll send the customer an interim timeline and mark the ticket accordingly. cc @patrick_compliance @elaine_security :eyes:
